name: Italy
filingNote: Calendar tax year. The Modello Redditi Persone fisiche is filed online by 31 October of the following year (for 2025: 2 November 2026, as 31 October 2026 is a Saturday). The Modello 730 is filed by 30 September.
lotRuleNote: The most recently bought coins count as sold first: Circolare 30/E §3.2.1 states the L.I.F.O. method for cripto-attività of the same denomination under the regime dichiarativo. A cost without proof counts as zero.

card.classification: Cripto-attività: gains and other proceeds from redemption, sale for consideration, swap, or holding are redditi diversi under a substitute tax (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c-sexies TUIR, added by L. 197/2022).

taxableEvents.note: A sale for euro is a disposal for consideration (cessione a titolo oneroso): the gain is the price received minus the documented cost or purchase value (art. 68 c. 9-bis TUIR, as the Istruzioni state it).

A swap between crypto-assets with the same characteristics and functions (ether bought with bitcoin, in the circular's example) is not a taxable event; the coins received take the cost of those given. A swap for an NFT is taxable.
A swap into an e-money token (a stablecoin its issuer redeems at par in an official currency) is a taxable event; a swap into an asset-referenced token is not (Circolare 30/E).

Paying with crypto swaps the coins for the good or service (permuta); only a swap between crypto-assets with the same characteristics and functions is outside the rule (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c-sexies TUIR).

Moving coins between wallets of the same owner is not a taxable event. Under the elective risparmio amministrato regime, a move to an account in someone else's name is a disposal unless made by gift or inheritance (Circolare 30/E §3.2.2).

No disposal for the giver. The recipient of a gift takes the giver's cost; an heir takes the value declared for inheritance tax (art. 68 c. 9-bis TUIR, as the Istruzioni state it). Inheritance and gift tax are a separate matter.
Proceeds from holding crypto (staking, in the circular's example) are redditi diversi taxed gross, with no deduction, since 1 January 2023 (art. 68 c. 9-bis TUIR, as Circolare 30/E §3.1 states it).

rates.label: Substitute tax on gains and other proceeds
rates.note: On gains and other proceeds realised from 1 January 2026 (L. 207/2024 art. 1 c. 24).

rates.label: Substitute tax, 2023 to 2025
rates.note: On gains and other proceeds realised up to 31 December 2025, declared in Quadro RT sezione V-A of the following year's return (the 2026 return for 2025); in 2023 and 2024 only the part above EUR 2,000 a year counted (Circolare 30/E §3.2.1).

rates.label: Proceeds from euro e-money tokens
rates.note: On income from holding, selling, or using e-money tokens denominated in euro (L. 199/2025 art. 1 c. 28); converting euro into such a token, or redeeming it at par, is not a realisation.

allowances: No threshold: L. 207/2024 art. 1 c. 25 removed the EUR 2,000 yearly amount below which gains and losses did not count, for disposals from 1 January 2025.
card.holdingRuleText: No holding rule: every sale is taxable whatever the holding time, from the first euro of gain since 1 January 2025. That covers a sale for euro, for a stablecoin that is an e-money token, or for goods. A swap between crypto-assets with the same characteristics and functions is not a taxable event (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c-sexies TUIR).
card.lotRuleText: Last in, first out: the coins acquired most recently count as sold first. Circolare 30/E §3.2.1 states it for the regime dichiarativo (“deve essere assunto come costo o valore di acquisto quello determinato con il metodo L.I.F.O.”).
card.losses: Losses offset gains of the same kind in the year; an excess carries forward to the fourth following year if declared in the return for the year it arose (art. 68 c. 9-bis TUIR, as the Istruzioni state it).
reporting: Quadro RT sezione V-A of the Modello Redditi Persone fisiche 2026 (quadro T of the 730) for gains and other proceeds realised up to 31 December 2025, taxed at 26 % (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c-sexies TUIR).

Quadro RW for crypto held, whatever the wallet. The 0.2 % yearly tax (imposta sulle cripto-attività, code 21 in colonna 3, codice tributo 1727) is due on the 31 December value, unless an intermediary applied stamp duty (imposta di bollo).
caveats: Which swaps count as between crypto-assets with the same characteristics and functions.
Staking rewards and airdrops: the gross-proceeds rule applies from 1 January 2023; the 26 % withholding by an Italian company that credits them was the circular's regime to 31 December 2022.
Disposals of 2025 whose price was received in 2026.
Quadro RW and the 0.2 % tax where an Italian exchange applies stamp duty.

Which cost method the intermediary applies: under the elective risparmio amministrato regime it uses the weighted-average cost, not last in, first out (Circolare 30/E §3.2.2). A question for an accountant.
The 2027 budget law, in Parliament on 5 November 2026.
Proof of cost: a cost without proof counts as zero.
card.summary60: Italy taxes crypto gains at a flat 33 % from 1 January 2026 (26 % in 2025), with no exempt amount or holding-period exemption. Swapping one crypto for a similar one is not taxed; selling for euro or e-money tokens is. Last-in, first-out. Losses carry forward 4 years. Holdings are reported yearly (Quadro RW, 0.2 % tax on value held).

pendingChanges.title: Testo unico delle imposte sui redditi (D.Lgs. 117/2026)
pendingChanges.summary: No change of rate: from 1 January 2027 the same rule is art. 304 c. 7 of the new text (D.Lgs. 117/2026).
